import numpy as np
# Find DTG peak in 450-800 C range
dtg = np.gradient(y1, x)
mask = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
idx_peak = np.argmin(dtg[mask]) + np.where(mask)[0][0]
x_peak = x[idx_peak]
y_peak = y1[idx_peak]
slope = dtg[idx_peak]
# Baseline: horizontal line at weight at 500 C
base_y = np.interp(500, x, y1)
# Onset: intersection of tangent and baseline
# Tangent: y - y_peak = slope * (x - x_peak)
# Baseline: y = base_y
# base_y - y_peak = slope * (x_onset - x_peak)
x_onset = x_peak + (base_y - y_peak) / slope
marks.append({'type': 'vline', 'x': float(x_onset), 'text': f'Onset {x_onset:.1f} °C'})
